description: NASA has successfully flown its 40-inch CATNLF laminar-flow wing model aboard an F-15B aircraft in January 2026. The test confirmed the drag-reducing design performs safely in flight. By maintaining smooth airflow over wings, the technology could improve fuel efficiency by up to 10 percent, lowering airline costs and reducing carbon emissions significantly.
title: NASA Successfully Tests Drag-Reducing Laminar-Flow Wing in Flight

description: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope has released a striking new image of the Egg Nebula, capturing a Sun-like star in its brief pre-planetary phase. Twin beams of light pierce glowing shells of dust and gas, offering astronomers a rare close-up view of stellar death about 1,000 light-years from Earth.
title: Hubble Reveals Dramatic Final Moments of a Sun-Like Star in the Egg Nebula

description: Google Chrome Flags are experimental browser settings that can enhance speed and responsiveness. Features like parallel downloading, GPU rasterisation, zero-copy rendering, Back-Forward Cache and QUIC can improve downloads, rendering, and navigation. However, because these are experimental tools, they should be enabled cautiously and reset if stability issues occur.
title: Best Google Chrome Flags to Make Your Browser Faster

description: If you’re looking for a Samsung phone under Rs. 25,000, here are some of the best options you can consider in 2026. The list includes the Galaxy A07 5G, Galaxy A17 5G, Galaxy M36 5G, Galaxy F36 5G, and Galaxy M34 5G. Most of these models offer AMOLED displays with up to 120Hz refresh rate, 50-megapixel rear camera units and 5,000mAh batteries. Some are equipped with Samsung's in-house Exynos chipset.

description: Oppo K14x 5G, Realme Narzo 90x 5G, and Redmi 15 5G compete in India’s budget 5G segment with similar pricing and large displays. While the Realme model begins at Rs. 13,999, the Oppo and Redmi options start at Rs. 14,999. title: Oppo K14x 5G vs Realme Narzo 90x 5G vs Redmi 15 5G: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: HP has launched six new DeskJet All-in-One printers in India across the DeskJet, Ink Advantage, and Ultra Ink Advantage series. Prices start at Rs. 6,999 for the DeskJet Ink Advantage 2986 and 2989, while the 4388 costs Rs. 7,999. Other models will be available for purchase soon. The printers support print, scan, and copy functions, manual duplex printing, dual-band Wi-Fi with self-healing, and mobile printing via the HP app. They include a 60-sheet tray, 1,000-page duty cycle, and a recycled plastic design.
title: HP Launches New DeskJet Ultra Ink Advantage, DeskJet Ink Advantage All-in-One Printers in India: Price, Features

description: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 has sold 5 million copies, developer Warhorse Studios has announced. The acclaimed RPG has reached the sales milestone in the first year of its release. KCD 2 is one of the highest rated games of 2025 and was nominated for Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025.
title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 Has Sold 5 Million Copies, Warhorse Studios Confirms

description: Medical Dialogues, an Indian medical journalism platform, announced that it has been selected to win the JournalismAI Innovation Challenge. It mentioned that it is the only publisher from the country to achieve the feat. The JournalismAI Innovation Challenge is a programme that funds projects from a wide range of news publishers to promote artificial intelligence (AI) fluency. The company said it was one of the 373 global publishers that applied to the competition.
title: Medical Dialogues Wins Google-Backed JournalismAI Innovation Challenge

description: Coinbase, the US-based cryptocurrency exchange platform, announced the launch of Agentic Wallet on Wednesday. The move comes amid rising interest in agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems that can execute tasks autonomously, including financial operations on blockchain networks. While AI agents have advanced in analysis and recommendations, executing transactions with real funds has remained limited by the need for human oversight and secure key management.
title: Coinbase Launches New Wallets to Let AI Agents Access and Trade Cryptocurrency

description: Lava Yuva Star 3 has been launched in India. The new phone comes in two colour options and has a 6.75-inch display and a 5,000mAh battery. It has an IP64-rated build for dust and splash resistance. Lava Yuva Star 3 has an AI-backed rear camera unit headlined by a 13-megapixel primary sensor. It has a 5-megapixel front-facing camera. The new phone will go on sale starting next month.
title: Lava Yuva Star 3 Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, 6.75-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Nike announced the launch of the Nike Domain 3 in India on Thursday as the latest addition to the Domain series. Nike said that Domain 3 has been engineered as a more responsive and stable platform tailored to the speed and intensity of the modern game.
title: Nike Domain 3 Cricket Footwear Launched in India With React Foam and Stability-Focused Design

The device also features a decent keyboard with short key travel and a large touchpad for a smooth typing and scrolling experience.

title: Infinix Note Edge 5G India Launch Date Announced, Flipkart Availability Confirmed: See Expected Specs

title: Xiaomi 18 Tipped to Feature Larger 6.4-inch Display, 200-Megapixel Periscope Telephoto Camera

Tasks was reportedly spotted in the iOS version of the app, but it might also be developed for Android at a later time.
title: Anthropic Reportedly Working on a Claude Cowork-Like Feature for iOS

description: Highguard developer Wildlight Entertainment has announced layoffs just two weeks after the release of the game. The studio did not specify the number of employees impacted by the cuts, but according to former staffers, most of the team has been laid off. Highguard launched on January 26 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X, but failed to make a dent on the highly-competitive hero shooter genre.
title: Highguard Developer Wildlight Entertainment Announces Layoffs After Player Numbers Decline

description: Honor has launched the budget 5G Honor X6d quietly in the UAE. Similar to the Honor Play 60A, it features a 6.75-inch HD+ LCD display, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, 4GB RAM, and 256GB storage. It is priced at AED 509 (roughly Rs. 12,600) and comes in Midnight Black and Ocean Cyan. The phone has a 50-megapixel rear camera, 5-megapixel selfie camera, 5,260mAh battery, and runs Android 15 with MagicOS 9.
title: Honor X6d Launched With 50-Megapixel Camera, 5,260mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Microsoft is working on changes to make Windows 11 more secure by default by limiting the apps and drivers that can run on the operating system. The Redmond-based tech giant is exploring a configuration where only properly signed applications and drivers would be allowed to execute on the system, unless users manually toggle the setting. This move is part of Microsoft’s broader push to strengthen Windows security in response to rising threats.
title: Microsoft Announces Windows 11 Baseline Security Mode to Limit Unsigned Apps and Drivers

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra’s renders have surfaced online again, along with the images of the Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26. The leaked renders show the design of the upcoming smartphones in greater detail. The entire Galaxy S26 series is shown to sport a pill-shaped rear camera module. However, the Ultra model appears with a quad rear camera unit, with one lens placed outside the camera island. Meanwhile, the standard and the plus models appear with triple rear camera setups. The three phones are shown in black colourways.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Seen in Leaked Renders That Give Us Yet Another Look at All Three Models

description: Truecaller has published its India Insights Report for 2025, offering insights about India's digital spam and scam landscape. It says a total of 4,168 crore spam calls were identified across India during the year. The app says it has blocked 1,189 crore spam calls in India last year.  This shows an average spam call duration of 1.8 minutes.  The company said it had identified around 770 crore fraud calls in the country last year.
title: Spammers Targeted Indian Users With Over 4,100 Crore Calls and 12,903 Crore Messages in 2025, Truecaller Says

description: Meta is rolling out the 'Dear Algo' feature on Threads. This AI-powered functionality gives users more control over what they see on their feeds. With this feature, users will be able to tell the app what’s important to them in the moment. To use the feature, users can type “Dear Algo” in a public Threads post, followed by what they’d like to see more or less of. The Dear Algo feature is currently available in select markets.
title: Threads Rolls Out ‘Dear Algo’ Feature That Lets Users Shape and Control Their Feed

description: The Vivo V70 series is scheduled to be launched in India in February as the successor to the V60, which was introduced in 2025. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the pricing of the Vivo V70 and Vivo V70 Elite has been leaked, suggesting that the brand is targeting different price segments with the standard and Elite variants. The Vivo V70 is tipped to be offered in two variants, while the V70 Elite may come with up to 12GB of RAM and up to 512GB of onboard storage.
title: Vivo V70, Vivo V70 Elite Price, Storage Configurations Tipped Ahead of India Launch

description: WhatsApp, the US-based instant messaging service, issued a statement on Thursday, claiming that the Russian government is attempting to "fully block" the app in the country. The company further added that with the ban, the government is driving Russian residents to use a state-owned platform, which WhatsApp is calling a "surveillance app". This comes months after a report pointed out that the Russian communication regulator had imposed a partial ban on WhatsApp and Telegram's voice calling services.
title: WhatsApp Says Russia Attempted to ‘Fully Block’ Service Months After Partial Ban

description: Microsoft is said to be considering merging its PC Game Pass and Game Pass Premium plans to streamline its game subscription offerings. The Xbox parent revamped Game Pass tiers in October when it introduced two new plans and hiked the prices of its subscription service. PC Game Pass is currently priced higher than Game Pass Premium and comes with day-one access for new games.
title: Microsoft Reportedly Considering Merging Game Pass Premium and PC Game Pass Tiers

description: OpenAI updated the Deep Research tool in ChatGPT this week. The agentic research assistant was first introduced by the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant in February 2025, and it was designed to help users conduct multi-step research on complex topics. Now, one year later, the company has added more controls and a new full-screen report viewer to the tool, allowing users more flexibility in both creating the research document and viewing it.
title: OpenAI Upgrades Deep Research in ChatGPT With More Controls, Full-Screen Viewer

description: Xiaomi 18 series and the Vivo X500 lineup will be launched in China with Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 and MediaTek Dimensity 9600 chipsets, respectively, a tipster claims. Interestingly, this year’s flagship Vivo X500 series is expected to include a Pro Max model this year, unlike its predecessor, which only features the standard Vivo X300 and Vivo X300 Pro phones. This comes months after the Vivo X300 lineup was unveiled in India in December 2025. Both phones are powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chip.
title: Xiaomi 18 Series, Vivo X500 Lineup Launch Timelines, Chipsets Tipped Months Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: Apple is said to have delayed a set of next-generation Siri features that were expected to debut with iOS 26.4. According to a seasoned journalist, the update was anticipated to bring more advanced contextual understanding, a personalised version of Siri, and deeper app integration to the company’s voice assistant, but development challenges appear to have slowed progress, and its release may be pushed further into the year.
